citation-support.goal: Distinguish support, contradiction, and insufficient support without silently dropping disputed cases.
guards: Retain correct answers and report review burden
citation-support.next_experiment: Review the thin-support reference independently before changing the question. A confidence gate is not a correction.

sarcasm-local.goal: Classify local textual intent; keep this population separate from cross-turn examples.
sarcasm-local.next_experiment: Obtain an independent challenge set; perfect agreement on twelve authored cases is not a general accuracy estimate.

sarcasm-context.goal: Use supplied context while keeping unresolved reference intent outside hard-label scoring.
guards: Do not define ambiguous truth using model confidence
sarcasm-context.next_experiment: Have an independent reviewer adjudicate or keep the ambiguous cases withheld. Do not use certainty as truth.

feed-triage.goal: Measure active/discard commitments separately from deferred review, against disclosed historical labels.
guards: Report review coverage and correct commitments separately
feed-triage.next_experiment: Ratify the intended watch policy and historical references before tuning. Raising a threshold can defer a disagreement without solving it.

sponsor-action.goal: Prove that ordered hearing/seek history and Noul answers produce the declared skip action.
guards: Skip limit and silence are not negative model predictions
sponsor-action.next_experiment: Label complete audio/transcript sequences independently, then capture live responses. Never claim skip-time accuracy from these fixtures.

moderation-action.goal: Keep model blocking judgment, categorical logging, and fail-open application behavior distinct.
guards: Missing category cannot bypass a block
Missing model verdict is not p=0
moderation-action.next_experiment: Choose and review a domain policy before live evaluation. These fixtures do not certify content moderation safety.
